name: material-ui
description: Material UI agent skills for styling, theming, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS integration.

interface.shortDescription: Build UI with Material UI styling, theming, Next.js, and Tailwind guidance
interface.longDescription:
Material UI is a React component library that implements Material Design. This plugin packages the repository's agent skills so coding agents can follow official guidance when working with @mui/material.

Use it when choosing among sx, styled(), theme overrides, and global CSS; building or extending themes with createTheme, colorSchemes, and CSS variables; wiring Material UI into Next.js App or Pages Router with @mui/material-nextjs; or combining Material UI with Tailwind CSS v4 layers (and v3 interoperability).

The skills point agents at the documented decision order and APIs — not at reading package source. Each skill's SKILL.md is the entry point; AGENTS.md is the full guide.
defaultPrompt: Style a Material UI Card with the right sx vs styled approach
Add light and dark color schemes to my Material UI theme
Set up Material UI with Next.js App Router and Emotion cache
